changes: Independent copy of E046 no-overflow design. Every fully-unrolled product is an explicit local variable bound to op=mul, impl=dsp.
conclusion: Choose a resource-feasible baseline for bank/storage and frequency scans.
interpretation: Determine actual multiply mapping and the remaining weight-bank, array-index mux, saturation-at-layer-boundary and AXI overhead. Actual full-frame bit comparison remains mandatory.
name: dataflow_dsp_T32
purpose: Force the 251 direct-convolution products per cycle onto DSPs. E033 default narrow multiplication used only 9 DSP but 136,868 LUT, exceeding the 81,984 LUT limit. Expected MAC DSP split 162/64/25 plus conversion/interface overhead; compute floor 2,080,800 cycles.
